name: Ghana
summary: West African coastal nation on the Gulf of Guinea. Akosombo Dam creates Lake Volta, the world's largest artificial reservoir by surface area, providing foundational clean power.

pm25.name: Annual Mean PM2.5 Exposure
pm25.source_dataset: State of Global Air (SOGA) 2024 / Global Burden of Disease
pm25.context: 8.24x the WHO 2021 annual guideline (5 µg/m³); Harmattan Saharan dust transport and Accra urban vehicular emissions.

temp_anomaly.name: Surface Temperature Anomaly
temp_anomaly.context: Relative to 1951-1980 baseline; coastal erosion and rising sea temperatures along the Gulf of Guinea.

temp_trend.name: 30-Year Warming Trend Rate
temp_trend.context: Linear warming rate across Ghanaian agro-ecological zones over 1994-2023.

co2_total.name: Total Territorial Fossil CO2
co2_total.context: 0.06% share of global fossil emissions; offshore gas from Jubilee and TEN fields utilized for power.

co2_per_capita.name: Per Capita Fossil CO2
co2_per_capita.context: Well below global average per capita rate; energy access rate exceeds 85% in urban areas.

forest_share.name: Forest Cover Fraction
forest_share.source_dataset: Global Forest Resources Assessment via World Bank (AG.LND.FRST.ZS)
forest_share.context: Guinean moist tropical forests and transitional savanna covering ~79,000 km².

renewables_share.name: Renewable Share of Electricity
renewables_share.context: Akosombo, Kpong, and Bui hydroelectric dams supply 35.2% of national power, with nascent solar.

population.name: Total Population & Density
population.context: Arithmetic population density of 150 people/km²; urban population fraction is 58.6%.
